parsed.name: UDP数据采样进程
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的软件组件，用于从 SPIDR 接收 Timepix 相关的 UDP 数据包，进行基础预处理、缓冲、转发以及可选的原始数据落盘，通常用于实验数据采集流水线中的前端接收环节。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that receives UDP packets from SPIDR carrying Timepix-related data, performs basic preprocessing, buffering, forwarding, and optional raw-data recording to disk. It is typically used as a front-end acquisition stage in an experimental data-processing pipeline.

actions.description: 初始化新进程中的连接与内部变量，并建立与后续数据处理模块的通信。
actions.description_en: Initialize connections and internal variables in the new process, and create communication with the downstream packet processor.

actions.description: 创建到 SPIDR 的 UDP 套接字连接，用于接收实验数据包。
actions.description_en: Create a UDP socket connection to SPIDR for receiving experimental data packets.

actions.description: 从接收到的数据包中提取有用内容和报头，供后续处理使用。
actions.description_en: Extract useful content and headers from a received packet for downstream processing.

actions.description: 获取或设置数据处理使能状态。
actions.description_en: Get or set the processing enabled state.

actions.description: 获取或设置原始数据写入磁盘的记录状态。
actions.description_en: Get or set the raw-data recording state for saving to disk.

actions.description: 获取或设置原始数据文件关闭请求。
actions.description_en: Get or set the raw-data file close request.

actions.description: 获取或设置输出文件名。
actions.description_en: Get or set the output file name.

actions.description: 在子进程正式运行前完成仅在新进程中可用的初始化准备。
actions.description_en: Perform initialization steps before execution that should only be available inside the child process.

actions.description: 在运行结束或超时后执行收尾处理，例如整理缓冲数据并处理文件关闭逻辑。
actions.description_en: Perform post-run cleanup after execution or timeout, such as finalizing buffered data and handling file-closing logic.

actions.description: 启动采样进程的主循环，持续接收 UDP 数据、筛选有效包、打包缓冲并转发或记录数据。
actions.description_en: Run the main acquisition loop that continuously receives UDP data, filters useful packets, buffers them, and forwards or records the data.
